proposal:
VERDICT: no credible universal mechanism and no polynomial SAT algorithm. Everything below is hand-derived, unexecuted and not machine-checked. One mechanism, an EXPERIMENT outside scc-emra-ialh5-v1: the root-only BLOCK-LINEALITY QUOTIENT (BLQ), run after Canon. It settles by hand the independent case of last round's U5 and targets the tree-substitution adversary that defeats OTPQ and FKQ.

REPRESENTATION. Group clauses by exact support S. Z_S in F_2^S is the set of falsifying points, one per clause. W_S = {w : Z_S+w = Z_S} is a subspace. A_S, the annihilator of W_S, is the canonical smallest space of GF(2)-linear forms through which the block factors; k_S = dim A_S. L is the sum of all A_S and r = dim L. All data are bit-vectors of length n, so there is no integer growth.

DISCOVERY.
(a) Stabilizer. Fix z0 in Z_S. Every w in W_S equals z+z0 for some z in Z_S, so at most |Z_S| candidates are tested by hashing: O(|Z_S|^2 |S|) bit operations, with no 2^|S| enumeration and no width cap.
(b) Atoms. Start from U = A_S and replace U by U∩A_T while some T gives 0 != U∩A_T != U. Fix a basis of the final cell U, pass to L/U with the family (A_T+U)/U, and recurse. Lift each later basis vector into the intersection of the A_T containing its image, by one linear solve. Crude bound: O(N n^5) bit operations for N blocks.
(c) Certificate. Accept the basis B only if rank(B∩A_S) = k_S for every S. Otherwise SKIP and leave F unchanged.

REWRITE. One fresh variable per element of B. Block S becomes |Z_S|/|W_S| clauses of width k_S, one per coset of W_S in Z_S.

SOUNDNESS S3 (hand proof). F(x) = F'(y(x)), and x -> y(x) is onto F_2^r because B is independent. So F is satisfiable iff F' is, and a model lifts by one linear solve. Variables r <= n, clauses <= m, widths <= |S|. S3 needs only the certificate (c), not the correctness of (b).

D1 (hand sketch). If a compatible basis exists, (b) finds one. Intersections of spans of subsets of one basis are spans of the intersections, so each final cell is a full class of basis vectors with identical block membership, and the quotient family stays compatible.

AFFINE CASE. A block with k_S = 1 is one GF(2) equation. Collect these and eliminate before (b). A width-w parity block costs 4^(w-1) w operations, polynomial in its own 2^(w-1) clauses. auto00005 then needs four stabilizers and a 4-row elimination with no window. This is restricted-family detection, not completeness.

SKIP. W_S != 0 forces |Z_S| even. Sorting supports costs O(|F| log |F|); if every block has odd size, BLQ exits. A k_S = 1 block has |Z_S| = 2^(|S|-1) exactly.

TRANSFER T2 (hand). Suppose Canon(F) is the exact-support encoding of G(l_1..l_m) with independent forms l_i. Then A_S is the image of the form-support of the merged base block. When those supports are coordinate subspaces the family is compatible, and BLQ returns a CNF on m variables equivalent to G up to recoding inside classes. This covers XOR lifts and tree substitution y_e = x_u xor x_v. It does not cover nonlinear gadgets (OTPQ's T1 does), so the two are incomparable.

FALSIFIABLE PREDICTIONS for BLQ, not for the deployed target.
P1: on the supplied auto00007 formula every block has |Z_S| = |W_S| = 16, r = 4, the certificate passes, and F' is (~a|b)(~b|c)(~c|~a)(a|d)(~d|b)(~c|~d). exact2SAT refutes it at root, so peak 0 against the observed 16. I rechecked the first block by hand: its 16 points have odd parity on {1,2,3} and even parity on {4,5,6}.
P2: on auto00006, r = 6 with nine binary clauses.
P3: on a path substitution y_i = x_i xor x_(i+1) over x1..x12 with any UNSAT 2-CNF G, r = 11 and widths are at most 3.
Falsifiers: a passed certificate where exhaustive SAT of F' differs from F refutes S3; a compatible family on which (b) returns SKIP refutes D1.
missing_theorem:
M0: S3, D1 and T2 are hand arguments, unchecked and untested. D1 leans on the fact that a family of subspaces has a common spanning basis iff it generates a distributive lattice. I recall this and have not verified it here.

FIRST UNSUPPORTED THEOREM, U6 (dependent forms): if the forms needed by the blocks are linearly dependent, some polynomial rewriting still shrinks F. REFUTED as stated. Take triangle edge forms y12, y23, y13 and blocks with form-supports A1 = span{y12,p}, A2 = span{y23,q}, A3 = span{y13,s} for independent p,q,s. Then (A1+A2)∩A3 = span{y13} while (A1∩A3)+(A2∩A3) = 0. The family is not distributive, so no compatible basis exists and (c) returns SKIP. This is not a discovery failure. G composed with dependent forms equals G plus cycle parity constraints, and the x-variables are already the compact potentials for those constraints. BLQ gains only the dimension of the common lineality space, here 1.

U7 (monotonicity): peak_current(F') <= peak_current(F) under the induced order. Unproved. Truncated window lists and DP tie-breaks differ between F and F'.

U8 (robust lineality): find in polynomial time the largest W such that Z_S is a union of W-cosets up to t exceptional clauses. Unproved; I expect hardness for unbounded t.

U4 (growth gap, unchanged): there is no polynomial residual-state bound for any family not already tractable. PHP and random 3-CNF have W_S = 0 for every block, so BLQ exits at the skip test and contributes nothing. T2 moves the adversary to the base formula and does not bound it.
self_attack:
1. T2 in the form 'returns G' is false after Canon. On a path u,v,w,z take C = (y_uv|y_vw) and D = (y_uv|y_wz). C's two width-3 clauses subsume two of D's four lifted clauses. The surviving block has Z = {0011,1100}, W = {0000,1111}, k = 3, and rewrites to (y_uv|~y_vw|y_wz). That is equivalent given C but wider than D. T2 must be stated on Canon(F), and the output is only equivalent to G.
2. Sabotage. One extra clause in one block of auto00007 makes |Z_S| = 17, so W_S = 0 and that block keeps six private coordinates; r rises from 4 to 8. One extra clause in every block makes BLQ a no-op. There is no robustness bound (U8).
3. Exact-support grouping ignores narrower clauses inside S. Including them means expanding subcubes, which is exponential in |S| minus the clause width, so I exclude it. An encoding that splits a block over several supports hides its stabilizer.
4. The compact AND lift from last round still defeats OTPQ tier 1 and BLQ together: the gadget is nonlinear and its clauses have different supports.
5. D1 is a sketch. If lifting fails on a compatible family, the cost is a missed reduction and never a wrong answer, because of (c). The O(N n^5) bound is unoptimised and unverified.
6. P1 to P3 are hand decodes. A misread sign changes the predicted quotient but not soundness.
7. When the skip test does not fire and (c) then fails, BLQ is pure root overhead, like the roughly 22x IALH overhead measured on auto00006. I give no cost-aware skip for IALH itself this round.
8. Node-wise use is not proposed. A branch on x_v cuts every W_S to its w_v = 0 part, so lineality decays under x-branching. Root-only use branches in y-space instead.
mechanism_signature: BLQ: root-only block-lineality quotient. Exact-support blocks; stabilizer W_S by |Z_S|^2 hashing, width-free; form-support A_S; GF(2) elimination of k_S=1 blocks; atom descent for a compatible basis; rank certificate; rewrite to r<=n variables with |Z_S|/|W_S| clauses per block. Inverts direct encodings of a CNF composed with independent linear forms. Experiment outside scc-emra-ialh5-v1.
delta_from_prior:
Last round OTPQ-2 inverted direct lifts by arbitrary gadgets with private variables. It named block lineality (U5) as an unsolved gap and tree substitution as a joint adversary of OTPQ and FKQ. New this round:
(1) U5 is settled by hand in the compatible case: width-free stabilizer computation, atom-descent discovery, a rank certificate that makes soundness independent of discovery, and bit-work bounds.
(2) T2 covers tree substitution, which OTPQ and FKQ miss.
(3) Explicit parity blocks of any width are recognised in time polynomial in their own clause count. This answers the auto00005 width gap without raising k.
(4) U6, the dependent-form extension, is refuted with a triangle example and a semantic reason.
(5) A Canon-interaction counterexample to exact recovery of G.
(6) An odd-block-size skip test.
(7) Checkable predictions P1 to P3, with P1 on the supplied auto00007 formula.
No universality claim; U4 is unchanged.
